title: My opinions on you!

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body: I see you as a friend. A month or so before your junior mod trial, I did kind of see you as a minimod, and not really in a good way. But, considering you were the only person who bothered making online reports and helped out a lot with rulebreakers, I thought you'd probably make a fine staff member which is why I recommended you. I like talking to you, and I'd like to keep it up. :)

replies.body: We've been friends for a really really long time! I enjoy talking to you, and although there are times where we get a bit salty towards each other it gets all g in the end. I sometimes get a bit annoyed by the way you dis the server, but I can see where you're coming from with a lot of your points. If I ever need help building a computer you're probably my go-to. :>

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body: I like you. You're mature and friendly, and you connect well with the community. You'd make a good moderator. I can't really call you a friend since we know nearly nothing about each other, but I hope that'll change soon. And that whole Operation Sudoku thing is something I'll never forget. Yikes. Oh, and it's nice seeing another violinist!

replies.body: One of the most professional players on the server. When you first joined the staff team, I thought it'd be a huge turning point but your abrupt retirement killed that whole thought. :P I hope to see you return to th team some day.

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body: Well, we've known each other for a long time, and we met during my time on my family account NuclearDucky. Back then you were just an ordinary fun guy who my siblings and I would play with, alth out you've changed throughout that time. Not quite in a bad way, but the whole "troll gimmick" thing can be a bit irritating at times. Other than that, it's nice seeing I stil have an older friend (not sure if I can call you that anymore since we never ever talk to each other) still around. :)

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body: Ah, yes. TheHoopsman! You were one of my good friends back when I was on NuclearDucky, and at the beginning of my new account. My sister and J would play with you a lot on NuclearDucky, but like always, your new staff position sort of made that fade away. Back then, a lot of my friends would end up becoming staff members and just drift away and that's kind of what happened to us. As an admin, you tend to do things like tell us about sudden events that cause controversy without giving us warnings or asking for our opinions. I can tell, though, that you've learned from it and decided to get some more words out of us, the mods. That's good, but I don't just want you to ask us for opinions, but not actually act upon what we say. :-)

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body: I don't know much about you other than that you're a somewhat active member, tend to stay in your own group of friends and don't really expand out much, and that you have been harassed because of your voice on TeamSpeak or something. Well, I saw that thread of yours so I suppose I could say you're a strong individual and people's comments on you don't stop you from doing what you want to do. You were a helpful moderator on your previous run I recall and I look forward to seeing how your current moderating state is. :3

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body: I don't know nearly anything about you, but on your first run as mod you didn't stand out to me and I believed you were taking it for granted. Then, you came back while I was on vacation and lost your rank, so I didn't get to see whether or not you had improved. You started out on the team with either no/hardly any friends, but roughy your days of moderating, I noticed you became quite the guy with a lot of people who liked you in the team. :D

replies.author: BoldAndBrash
replies.body: Where do I start? Back when I was just a normal regular on the server, you were one toxic son of a gun. :^) You'd always complain and yell at your teammates, and it'd always bug me. xD But later on, you became a much better guy. I got my mod rank and didn't really hate you anymore. Then, when you got yours, we actually became friends. Your cheese puff addiction, penguin obsession, and your GOT memes truly set you aside from all other people. You went from a pest to being one of my favorite people, Pingu! ;D
